text: Pinned source resolves emd through optional backends: emdist first, otherwise T4transport::sinkhornD, then transport. The existing frozen R lock selects T4transport, so the method label does not establish general exact-EMD semantics. Preserve that backend identity and do not alter the global lock, which would silently switch prior fixtures. Qualify independent analytically exact small transport plans (Dirac diagonal distance sqrt(2), two-pair split distance 1) beside the actual pinned outputs, native sliced W1 and squared-cost Sinkhorn. No native LP/network-simplex solver and no approximation relabeling. General exact-backend equivalence is not claimed.
